property_summary: For any fuzzed caller and values, calling Collect(...) on the correct C never changes MinSum (MinSum remains equal to its pre-call value); the mutant that inverts the nonReentrant_ require can allow MinSum to be changed for some inputs (via a reentrant helper), so the property is violated there.
change_summary: Invert the require to allow entry only when locked_ is true, changing when guarded functions (including SetMinSum) can run.
